description: ecoinvent 3.12's one `Propyl propionate` row carries 623-53-0, ethyl methyl carbonate's number, and the five-list build of 5f06833 published it as that carbonate on EF 3.1's flow. ecoinvent 3.13, released 2026-11-04, registers the uuid 106-36-5, propyl propanoate, and 3.12 is corrected to match.

expectations.title: The ecoinvent `Propyl propionate` row lands on propyl propionate, 106-36-5
expectations.comment: On 5f06833 the one 3.12 row, b842b096, carried 623-53-0 -- ethyl methyl carbonate -- and was matched to EF 3.1's flow of that carbonate and published as `Ethyl Methyl Carbonate`. ecoinvent 3.13 registers the uuid 106-36-5 and 3.12 is corrected to match; EF 3.1 has no propyl propionate flow, so the row creates the substance.
